sources.snippet: Each is a Hugging Face Hub artifact with weights, a rskill.yaml manifest, quantization hints, latency budgets and reproducible eval. Install like a model: openral rskill install OpenRAL/rskill-smolvla-franka_panda-libero_spatial-bf16.
